trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The toad can breathe air and water.

action.name: Tongue Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition prone} condition.

items.name: Croak
entries: Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition deafened} condition.
